claim: The model covers the 18 dated inventory classes while preserving covered/planned/open distinctions.
review_question: Check each row, tool/practice description and boundary; distinguish an existing tool from the programme capability being planned.

claim: Diagram quality relates to generated-code behaviour in bounded sequence-diagram experiments.
locations: JSON E03 and E51; PDF pp. 3, 16; v0.3: E51 moderator (precedence), E76 (explanatory artefacts)
review_question: Inspect execution versus fidelity, experimental units, suite construction and transfer beyond diagrams. Do not infer production or whole-inventory causality.

claim: Author-less repair can pass gates while preserving or inventing wrong semantics.
status: M for reported arm; H for organization-wide consequences
locations: PDF R4, p. 10; p. 16; JSON E27–E31
review_question: Audit the L1/L2 comparisons and denominators. Passing a gate is not an intended-behaviour guarantee; avoid a blanket anti-repair conclusion.

claim: Author participation improved reported repair outcomes in a bounded with-author arm.
review_question: This result is less prominent in the PDF. Assess balance, LLM-author limitations, leakage audit, residual failures and causal interpretation.

claim: Upstream errors can enter dependent artefacts, implementation and tests.
status: H overall; bounded M for the model-to-code leg and, since v0.3, for the reverse leg code-to-artefacts (E73, E74)
review_question: Demand an explicit inheritance mechanism, dependency conditions, independent downstream fault sources and observation strategy.

claim: Shared wrong premises can make tests and code agree, concealing errors.
status: M, bounded (one instance; premise originating in code), per pumllint #205 F2; H for the organisation-wide pathway
locations: PDF p. 3; JSON E52–E54, E69–E70; v0.3: E73, E78 (diverse derivation as a detection input)
review_question: Check that the full common-mode pathway is labelled as a mechanism, not directly measured by the cited repair experiment.

claim: Impact can grow through reach, detection delay, correction scope and operational exposure.
review_question: Keep spread, severity, repair cost and exposure separate. No universal multiplier or monotonic decline. Do not count copies as independent root defects.

claim: Independent validation and outcome-led correction can interrupt the cascade.
locations: PDF pp. 3, 10–11; JSON E56–E58, E66–E67, E70; B3; v0.3: E77 (drift feeds confidence without repair), E78, E79
review_question: Check independence, authority, incentives, response capacity and delays. Observing harm does not automatically cause learning.

claim: Gate burden can increase waiting, batching and bypass.
review_question: Do the local signs, conditions and loop closure follow? Compare prevention benefit with gate and approval burden.

claim: Quality interventions may affect each DORA metric through different conditional paths.
status: H for tool effects; definitions from S4
locations: PDF p. 4; JSON metrics and delivery edges
review_question: Check boundaries and denominators; deployment rework differs from all rework; fewer failures alone do not imply shorter recovery time.

claim: All nine quality elements matter, while inventory coverage is uneven.
locations: PDF pp. 2, 5–8; JSON quality and inventory
review_question: Q4 has no explicit direct inventory assignment. Decide whether this is an appropriately identified gap or an omitted justified pathway; do not force benefits into every category.

claim: The model should support participatory systemic design and sustained learning.
locations: PDF pp. 13–16; JSON actors, systemic_elements, hypotheses
review_question: Distinguish a plan to engage people from completed participation. Review power, conflicting priorities, ownership and how new evidence reframes the challenge.

claim: Knowledge held only by people is a source of upstream omission and of the assumptions a builder records; eliciting, externalising and validating it acts on both.
status: H for the edges; M, bounded, for the indicator (assumption-register entries per artefact set)
locations: JSON node tacit, E71-E72, stocks N and P, practices P10-P12; PDF p. 3 (people source)
review_question: The pilot that would measure this has not run. Check that no edge from capture reaches a delivery metric, and that the strong and weak senses of tacit are kept apart in the definitions.
